name: electron-monitoring
description: Playwright-driven Electron freeze-detection harness. Runs scenarios against an Electron app, detects freezes across 6 layers (renderer UI thread, longtask/LoAF attribution, main-process event loop, hardware CPU/mem/GPU, native unresponsive, deep CDP evidence), correlates each freeze to the UI action that triggered it, and emits a Markdown sign-off report + visual HTML timeline.
